note: Curated licence ELECTIONS and CORRECTIONS that take precedence over license-index.json when the SBOM is generated and when the licence gate runs. Each entry is a human disposition of a dual-licence choice, a non-SPDX string, or a package whose LOCKED version carries no licence grant. Source: docs/audits/M0.5-dependency-sbom.md §3. Keep this list tight — it is an override of registry truth and every entry must be justified.
